messages:
elaine (sales): Mercator asked for a concise perf POC + price/security brief. Goal: 400 QPS sustained for 30m, p95 <120ms, NA+EU, fallback path to dedicated. They want KMS/BYOK details and SSO. Can eng propose a heatmap + short runbook?

tom (eng-reliability): Yep. Need model variant, avg token sizes, and whether generation is streamed.

ravi (solutions): From call: 13B-class model. Test fp16 primary, q4 fallback. Avg input ~50 tokens, output ~120. Mix ~65% stream-gen, 35% embed/rerank.

nina (eng-runtime): Plan: sweep at 100/200/300/400 QPS + short microbursts (30s and 2m). Capture p50/p95/p99, gpu util, batch sizes, KV cache hit. Will run both quant and fp16.

tom (eng-reliability): Runbook sketch:
- Prep: preload keys, warm KV cache with 10k prefixes
- Smoke: 5m at 100 QPS
- Main: run each sweep for 30m, record metrics + traces
- Failover: simulate region outage and validate dedicated fallback
(We will commit full runbook to the ops ticket.)

paul (finance): Quick ballpark: 400 QPS -> ~34.56M req/mo. At ~160 tokens/req => ~5.5B tokens/mo. Hosted @ $0.0003/token => ~$1.65M/mo. Dedicated reserved ~ $180k-350k/mo depending on commit. Will refine post-baseline.

sec (security): Checklist: SOC2 ok, SSO (SAML/OIDC) supported, KMS/BYOK supported. HSM requires private deployment (~4-8w). Data residency/audit logging noted.

ravi (solutions): Contract note: Mercator legal wants model provenance + regression guardrail. Recommend a clause referencing Redwood Optimize evals.

ops-bot: Created POC ticket: mercator-poc-1747001234, window=2025-06-12T18:00:00Z, owners @tom @nina.

elaine (sales): Thanks. Please post a one-pager runbook + single-slide cost compare by EOD. I'll request a 10-sample seed set from Mercator for quality checks.

tom (eng-reliability): I'll take the runbook and smoke run. Smoke tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

nina (eng-runtime): I'll drop heatmap scripts and fallback config. Will include cache sensitivity scenarios.

paul (finance): After baseline, I'll publish hosted vs dedicated numbers with cache-hit sensitivity table.

elaine (sales): Sharing contact: poc@mercator.example.com. Keeping thread for run updates.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: mercator-poc-1747001234 starts in ~24h.
